values.subject: Third-party resurvey record: foyer-corner benchmark elevation and drain-status observation
values.body_text: XA-GR-0625 resurvey was based on a 24-point elevation grid and actual-rain observation at the site. The local slope at the foyer corner deviates from the linear drainage channel, and a finished-surface elevation difference at connection exists at the drainage-channel connection; all other recorded points drained on schedule after the actual rain at the site. We recommend opening only the affected pavement and adjusting the connection; nursery-stock root zones and outdoor-light wiring are outside the scope of this removal work.

values.title: Rain-test drain-status timing zero-point explanation
values.body: Use cessation of rain or cessation of water supply as the zero point, then record the ten-minute, thirty-minute, and fully drained statuses separately; timestamps on the original photos must not be overwritten.
